instruction:
You are a construction staging engineer checking a task-owned synthetic SSC-16 package for environmental controls, temporary traffic control, monitoring communications, and temporary power readiness.

Use only the task-owned synthetic source pack values shown below for numeric grading. External EPA CGP/SWPPP, FHWA MUTCD temporary-traffic-control, SYNCHRO 4D staging, and construction inspection/reporting routes shape the workflow context only; they are not extra data sources for this instance.

## Scene

- Construction stage: `STG-SSC16-001`
- Work zone: `WZ-16-A`
- Temporary traffic control plan: `TTC-01`
- Erosion and sediment control plan: `ESCP-01`
- Sediment basin: `SB-01`
- Monitoring station: `MON-01`
- Temporary power board: `TPB-01`
- Solar/battery unit: `PV-BAT-01`
- Inspection record: `INSP-01`
- Hold point: `HP-ENV-TRAFFIC-01`

## Stormwater And Sediment Basin

| Item | Value |
|------|-------|
| Disturbed catchment area draining to SB-01 | {{ disturbed_area_ac }} acres |
| 2-year, 24-hour design storm depth | {{ design_storm_depth_in }} in |
| Runoff coefficient | {{ runoff_coefficient }} |
| Provided SB-01 basin storage | {{ provided_basin_volume_ft3 }} ft3 |
| Provided basin freeboard | {{ provided_freeboard_ft }} ft |
| Required freeboard | {{ required_freeboard_ft }} ft |
| TSS event mean concentration | {{ tss_event_mean_concentration_mg_l }} mg/L |

Stormwater checks:

- Runoff volume equals `disturbed_area_ac x 43,560 x design_storm_depth_in / 12 x runoff_coefficient`.
- Required basin volume equals the calculated runoff volume for this source pack.
- Basin storage headroom equals provided basin storage minus required basin volume.
- Freeboard margin equals provided freeboard minus required freeboard.
- TSS event load equals `runoff_volume_ft3 x 28.316846592 x TSS_mg_L / 453592.37`.

## Temporary Traffic Control

| Item | Value |
|------|-------|
| Work-zone posted speed | {{ work_zone_speed_mph }} mph |
| Lane shift width | {{ lane_shift_width_ft }} ft |
| Provided TTC-01 taper length | {{ provided_taper_length_ft }} ft |
| Channelizer spacing | {{ channelizer_spacing_ft }} ft |
| Provided channelizer count | {{ provided_channelizer_count }} devices |

Temporary traffic checks:

- For this low-speed TTC source pack, taper length equals `lane_shift_width_ft x work_zone_speed_mph^2 / 60`.
- Taper headroom equals provided taper length minus required taper length.
- Minimum channelizer count equals `ceil(required_taper_length / channelizer_spacing) + 1`.
- Channelizer headroom equals provided channelizer count minus minimum channelizer count.

## Monitoring, Communications, And Temporary Power

| Device | Data load | Power load |
|--------|-----------|------------|
| Work-zone camera CAM-16-01 | {{ camera_data_mbps }} Mbps | {{ work_zone_camera_load_w }} W |
| Turbidity logger TURB-01 | {{ turbidity_logger_data_mbps }} Mbps | {{ turbidity_logger_load_w }} W |
| Weather station WX-01 | {{ weather_station_data_mbps }} Mbps | {{ weather_station_load_w }} W |
| Cellular gateway GW-01 | {{ gateway_data_mbps }} Mbps | {{ cellular_router_load_w }} W |

Temporary power checks:

- Total monitoring data load is the sum of the four device data loads.
- Monitoring load is the sum of the four device power loads.
- Battery autonomy equals `battery_capacity_wh x usable_battery_fraction / monitoring_load_w`.
- Solar daily energy equals `solar_panel_power_w x peak_sun_hours x solar_derate_factor`.
- Solar daily headroom equals solar daily energy minus `monitoring_load_w x 24`.

| Temporary power source | Value |
|------------------------|-------|
| Battery capacity | {{ battery_capacity_wh }} Wh |
| Usable battery fraction | {{ usable_battery_fraction }} |
| Solar panel power | {{ solar_panel_power_w }} W |
| Peak sun hours | {{ peak_sun_hours }} h/day |
| Solar derate factor | {{ solar_derate_factor }} |

## Inspection Readiness

| Item | Value |
|------|-------|
| Inspection interval | {{ inspection_interval_days }} days |
| Days since last inspection | {{ days_since_last_inspection }} days |

Inspection check:

- Inspection days remaining equals inspection interval minus days since last inspection.

## Output Format

Write a compact memo to `/workspace/output.md`. Include a source-boundary statement that this is a task-owned synthetic source pack. Explain the calculations briefly, preserve the object IDs above, and state that the baseline source pack passes the current docs-only checks.

Do not claim authority approval, accepted project evidence, software export validity, full standards compliance, executable source-pack hardening, generated benchmark readiness, or benchmark readiness.

Include a fenced JSON block with exactly these numeric keys:

```json
{
  "runoff_volume_ft3": <numeric_value>,
  "required_basin_volume_ft3": <numeric_value>,
  "basin_storage_headroom_ft3": <numeric_value>,
  "freeboard_margin_ft": <numeric_value>,
  "tss_load_lb": <numeric_value>,
  "taper_length_ft": <numeric_value>,
  "taper_headroom_ft": <numeric_value>,
  "minimum_channelizer_count": <numeric_value>,
  "channelizer_headroom_count": <numeric_value>,
  "total_monitoring_data_mbps": <numeric_value>,
  "monitoring_load_w": <numeric_value>,
  "battery_autonomy_h": <numeric_value>,
  "solar_daily_headroom_wh": <numeric_value>,
  "inspection_days_remaining": <numeric_value>
}
```

[meta]
name = "construction-stage-controls-package"
description = "SSC-16 construction environmental controls, temporary traffic, and monitoring power metrics"
long_description = "Calculates source-bound construction stage readiness metrics from a deterministic SSC-16 task-owned source pack. The template aggregates EPA CGP-style stormwater runoff and basin readiness, MUTCD-style temporary traffic taper and channelizer checks, monitoring data load, battery/solar autonomy, and inspection timing for a compact generated task instance."
discipline = "civil"
category = "construction-staging"
standards = ["EPA CGP", "FHWA MUTCD Part 6", "SYNCHRO 4D", "construction inspection records"]
tags = ["civil", "construction", "staging", "stormwater", "temporary-traffic", "monitoring", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

[params.disturbed_area_ac]
type = "float"
unit = "acre"
description = "Disturbed catchment area draining to SB-01"
min = 4.8
max = 4.8

[params.design_storm_depth_in]
type = "float"
unit = "in"
description = "2-year, 24-hour storm depth for sediment basin readiness"
min = 2.1
max = 2.1

[params.runoff_coefficient]
type = "float"
description = "Runoff coefficient for disturbed construction catchment"
min = 0.72
max = 0.72

[params.provided_basin_volume_ft3]
type = "float"
unit = "ft3"
description = "Provided SB-01 sediment basin storage volume"
min = 31500.0
max = 31500.0

[params.provided_freeboard_ft]
type = "float"
unit = "ft"
description = "Provided SB-01 freeboard"
min = 1.4
max = 1.4

[params.required_freeboard_ft]
type = "float"
unit = "ft"
description = "Required SB-01 freeboard for this source pack"
min = 1.0
max = 1.0

[params.tss_event_mean_concentration_mg_l]
type = "float"
unit = "mg/L"
description = "Construction runoff TSS event mean concentration"
min = 185.0
max = 185.0

[params.work_zone_speed_mph]
type = "float"
unit = "mph"
description = "Posted work-zone speed used for TTC-01 taper check"
min = 35.0
max = 35.0

[params.lane_shift_width_ft]
type = "float"
unit = "ft"
description = "TTC-01 lane shift width"
min = 11.0
max = 11.0

[params.provided_taper_length_ft]
type = "float"
unit = "ft"
description = "Provided TTC-01 taper length"
min = 250.0
max = 250.0

[params.channelizer_spacing_ft]
type = "float"
unit = "ft"
description = "TTC-01 channelizer spacing"
min = 25.0
max = 25.0

[params.provided_channelizer_count]
type = "float"
unit = "count"
description = "Provided TTC-01 channelizing device count"
min = 12.0
max = 12.0

[params.turbidity_logger_load_w]
type = "float"
unit = "W"
description = "TURB-01 logger power load"
min = 8.0
max = 8.0

[params.weather_station_load_w]
type = "float"
unit = "W"
description = "WX-01 weather station power load"
min = 5.0
max = 5.0

[params.cellular_router_load_w]
type = "float"
unit = "W"
description = "GW-01 cellular gateway power load"
min = 9.0
max = 9.0

[params.work_zone_camera_load_w]
type = "float"
unit = "W"
description = "CAM-16-01 work-zone camera power load"
min = 18.0
max = 18.0

[params.battery_capacity_wh]
type = "float"
unit = "Wh"
description = "PV-BAT-01 nominal battery capacity"
min = 2400.0
max = 2400.0

[params.usable_battery_fraction]
type = "float"
description = "PV-BAT-01 usable battery fraction"
min = 0.80
max = 0.80

[params.solar_panel_power_w]
type = "float"
unit = "W"
description = "PV-BAT-01 solar panel rated power"
min = 400.0
max = 400.0

[params.peak_sun_hours]
type = "float"
unit = "h/day"
description = "Peak sun hours for the selected stage"
min = 3.6
max = 3.6

[params.solar_derate_factor]
type = "float"
description = "Solar derate factor"
min = 0.75
max = 0.75

[params.camera_data_mbps]
type = "float"
unit = "Mbps"
description = "CAM-16-01 data load"
min = 3.5
max = 3.5

[params.turbidity_logger_data_mbps]
type = "float"
unit = "Mbps"
description = "TURB-01 data load"
min = 0.2
max = 0.2

[params.weather_station_data_mbps]
type = "float"
unit = "Mbps"
description = "WX-01 data load"
min = 0.1
max = 0.1

[params.gateway_data_mbps]
type = "float"
unit = "Mbps"
description = "GW-01 telemetry overhead data load"
min = 0.4
max = 0.4

[params.inspection_interval_days]
type = "float"
unit = "days"
description = "INSP-01 routine inspection interval"
min = 7.0
max = 7.0

[params.days_since_last_inspection]
type = "float"
unit = "days"
description = "Elapsed days since INSP-01 was last completed"
min = 6.0
max = 6.0

[outputs.runoff_volume_ft3]
description = "Runoff volume to SB-01 from the selected design storm"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.required_basin_volume_ft3]
description = "Required SB-01 basin volume for the selected source-pack rule"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.basin_storage_headroom_ft3]
description = "Provided SB-01 storage minus required basin volume"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.freeboard_margin_ft]
description = "Provided SB-01 freeboard minus required freeboard"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.tss_load_lb]
description = "Estimated event TSS load from construction runoff"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.taper_length_ft]
description = "Required TTC-01 taper length"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.taper_headroom_ft]
description = "Provided TTC-01 taper length minus required taper length"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.minimum_channelizer_count]
description = "Minimum TTC-01 channelizer count along the required taper"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.channelizer_headroom_count]
description = "Provided TTC-01 channelizer count minus minimum count"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.total_monitoring_data_mbps]
description = "Total monitoring data load through GW-01"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.monitoring_load_w]
description = "Total monitoring power load on PV-BAT-01"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.battery_autonomy_h]
description = "PV-BAT-01 battery autonomy for the monitoring load"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.solar_daily_headroom_wh]
description = "PV-BAT-01 solar daily energy minus monitoring daily load"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.inspection_days_remaining]
description = "Days remaining before the next routine inspection is due"
tolerance = 0.03
